text_block_list.text:
One afternoon—for a special feature in the school paper,
Fine Motion and Air Groove were having a photo shoot
in their racing racewear.

text_block_list.name: Newspaper Committee Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Fine-san, Air Groove-san,
could you look a little more this way, please?"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
Will this be satisfactory?

text_block_list.name: Newspaper Committee Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
It's absolutely perfect!
Asking the two of you for the 'Dignified in Racing Gear' feature
was definitely the right call...!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Not at all, I'm just glad you're pleased with it.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Racewear is proof of one's feelings... was it?

Fine Motion nodded with a smile at those words.
Even the first time she put on her racing silks, she had—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hey, how do I look?
In my racing racewear, I mean.
choice_data_list: It suits you really well, congratulations...!!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Fufu, thank you, Trainer♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh, if you like it that much,
should we give Trainer's jacket the same design?

...Teased by her all the while,
I head to the press conference to unveil her racewear.
After all, she is a foreign VIP, so the mere arrival of her racing Racewear is major news that draws crowds of reporters.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
That I have received the honor of donning this Racewear
is all thanks to the immense support of so many—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I would like to express my deepest gratitude
to everyone involved and to all the fans who support me.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations!
If you don't mind, please share your aspirations for the future.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Without letting complacency take hold, I will give my all—
striving always to run in a manner
that brings honor to Ireland.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Some voice concern that being so engrossed in running
might interfere with your official duties, however!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...Please take another look at my racing outfit.
It is adorned throughout with shamrocks, whose
language of flowers signifies 'promise.'

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: "This racing attire is a promise sworn to Ireland, and proof of my own heartfelt feelings."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: The pride I hold, the ideals I point toward, and the future I tread shall always be with Ireland.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"As one who holds this nation dear in my heart,
I have not forgotten that even once."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: "Both as one who carries the name of Ireland and as a competitor, I intend to keep striving so that I may remain an existence to be proud of on both fronts."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Your concerns are completely justified. That is all the more reason
for you to watch me run... and judge my resolve for yourself.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Haaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I won't lose!!
My feelings... my pride... are on the line!!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: Incredible...! She's biting right at the heels of the "Empress"...!

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text: I thought it was just a carefree pastime for the upper class, but could that girl be—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"...I think I've done all that I can now.
Don't people in this country have a saying for this?
'Do what is humanly possible, and leave the rest to fate.'"
choice_data_list: I'm sure your resolve got through to them!
You looked even cooler than usual.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I hope so.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Upbringing, environment, tastes, and beliefs—no two people
are identical... So it's probably difficult
to be understood by everyone, but still.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"I hope today's press conference reached
as many people as possible with my feelings!"

...And while I was lost in memories of the past,
the photoshoot seemed to conclude without a hitch.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
There you are, Trainer!
Here, a present.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
I'm honored to hear you say that♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Putting on my racing silks really braces me, you could say...
It feels like the outfit itself is giving me a push forward.
choice_data_list: I'm rooting for you too, Fine.
I'm cheering for you too, Fine.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. I've gotta keep showing everyone
that this isn't just child's play!

...And while I was lost in memories of the past,
the photoshoot seemed to conclude without a hitch.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
There you are, Trainer!
Here, a present.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I found it during the shoot.
They might not be a matching pair of jackets,
but now we're matching!
Saying that, Fine Motion handed over a clover... a shamrock.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
As long as time permits, I shall continue to run.
Forever and always, right by your side—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"As partners sharing the same ambition,
I look forward to continuing to work with you, Trainer!"

Tucking the token of promise she gave me into my chest pocket,
I showed my respect for her trust and resolve.
